title: 6.13 I have a reservation
unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
goal: Check in at a hotel: say you have a reservation, take your key and ask what floor your room is on (I have a reservation. Here's your key. It's on the fifth floor.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.13 In the City: A1 names a city, a hotel and things to visit; A1+ 6.13 checks in at the hotel. The new items are reservation (I have a reservation.), the handing-over phrase Here's your … (Here's your key.), elevator, and the question What floor is my room on? answered with 2.6-2.7's ordinals (It's on the fifth floor.). Four photos follow Ana through one hotel: at the front desk with her passport, taking her key, stepping out of the elevator and smiling in her room. The floor is never shown in a photo, so which floor is only heard.
prerequisite: A1 6.13 hotel; A1+ 2.6-2.7 floors and ordinals; A1+ 6.2 takes; A1+ 6.5 passport.
speaking_outcome: Stress res-er-VA-tion and EL-e-va-tor; link Here's your (HEERZ-yer). Do not require native-like speed.
